name: TANAY TIJARE

experience.description: Designed and developed a multi-service backend system using FastAPI, splitting authentication and data-validation concerns into two independently deployable microservices communicating over REST. Implemented JWT-based authentication and authorization with bcrypt password hashing, and integrated SQLAlchemy ORM with PostgreSQL for secure, efficient data management. Built a dynamic CSV validation engine using Pandera with configurable, database-stored validation rules, processing large files in chunks via Pandas to handle high-volume data without memory overload. Configured Nginx as a reverse proxy to route traffic across services, and containerized the full stack using Docker and docker-compose for consistent deployment across environments. Set up a Jenkins CI/CD pipeline running in Docker to automate build and deployment workflows, reducing manual release effort.

projects.name: Spring Boot RESTful Microservice for Managing Hotel Reviews
projects.description: Developed a three-layered architecture using Spring Boot and Spring JPA, integrated with MySQL (in-memory database) for efficient data handling. Implemented CRUD operations for hotel reviews and business logic, improving data processing speed by 30%. Integrated Swagger for API documentation, enhancing developer onboarding and reducing integration time by 25%. Configured Spring Actuator for health checks and status monitoring, improving system reliability and reducing downtime by 20%.

projects.name: Customer Segmentation and Purchase Prediction System
projects.description: Developed an AI-powered analytics system to process CSV data for RFM analysis, churn prediction, customer segmentation, and market basket analysis to support targeted marketing strategies. Built and trained deep learning models using TensorFlow/Keras to identify churn-prone customers and segment users based on behavioral patterns. Performed data preprocessing, feature engineering, and exploratory data analysis using Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, and Seaborn to improve data quality and model performance. Created an interactive web application using Flask and Streamlit to enable data upload, visualization of insights, and access to predictive outputs.
responsibilities: Built and trained deep learning models

professional_summary: Backend Engineer specializing in FastAPI, RESTful API design, microservices architecture, and JWT-based authentication.

internships.description: Performed data analysis and visualization using Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, and Seaborn to support insights and improve internal reporting workflows. Collaborated with senior engineers on debugging, code reviews, and applying Python best practices to enhance code quality and maintainability. Documented technical processes and developed reusable modules, reducing repetitive development effort and improving overall development efficiency.
